name: 07107 · Newark, NJ
findings: ZIP 07107 (Newark) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (71% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07107 (Newark) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07107 (Newark) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
